about: A JavaScript library of helpers for working with parsed HTML and XML pages.

prs.title: Atom feeds give the page link, not the comments or feed link
prs.broken: Reading an Atom feed took whichever link came first. On Blogger that was the comments feed, and on YouTube or Reddit it was the feed's own address, not the page.
prs.changed: I made it pick the link that points to the page, as the Atom standard says, and fall back to the first one.
prs.matters: Feed readers built on it open the actual post when you click it.
